name: External Trade Market 1 Code
definition: Specifies the external trade market code in the format of character string with a maximum length of 4 characters.|External code sets can be downloaded from www.iso20022.org.

FDMS.name: Factoring Domestic
FDMS.definition: Factoring service provider, Factoring client and third party in the same country

FEXP.name: Factoring Export
FEXP.definition: Factoring service provider, Factoring client in the same country, third party in another country

FFDM.name: Factoring Foreign Domestic
FFDM.definition: Factoring client and third party in the same country, Factoring service provider in another country

FFDT.name: Factoring French Dom Tom
FFDT.definition: Factoring service provider, Factoring client and third party in the same country, but factoring client has an exceptional VAT ruling, for example if it’s overseas

FIMP.name: Factoring Import
FIMP.definition: Factoring service provider and third party in the same country, Factoring client in another country

FREX.name: Factoring Reexported Export
FREX.definition: Factoring service provider, Factoring client and third party in three different countries
